basic_details.job_title: MSRLS Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 5 Project Manager, District Functional Specialist Posts
basic_details.short_information: Citizens of Meghalaya within 35 years of age can apply online for 5 contractual posts – 2 Project Managers at ₹46,800/- per month and 3 District Functional Specialists at ₹39,000/- per month – with the Meghalaya State Rural Livelihoods Society (MSRLS), the nodal agency of the Government of Meghalaya for implementing NRLM, Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. The online application on msrls.nic.in opens at 10:00 am on 12 November 2026 and closes at 5:00 pm on 26 November 2026. No application fee is charged.

age_limit.details: For every post, the age limit is "within 35 years of age". The notice does not print a cut-off date for counting age. | Category Relaxation SC/ST Maximum age relaxable by five years Persons with Disabilities (PWDs) Ten years (fifteen years for SC/ST), as per the extant policy of the Government of Meghalaya | For the full discipline-specific eligibility of each post, check Annexure I and Annexure II of the official notification.

content_sections.heading: About MSRLS
content_sections.text: The Meghalaya State Rural Livelihoods Society is the nodal agency of the Government of Meghalaya for implementing NRLM under the Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. Its office is at Montfort Building, 2nd Floor, Dhanketi, Shillong-793001. This recruitment fills posts at its State Mission Management Unit (SMMU) and its District Mission Management Units (DMMUs).

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: MSRLS has advertised 5 posts, one vacancy for each post. Two posts are at the State Mission Management Unit and three at the District Mission Management Units. The annexures give the place of each post: PM-NFM (1 Post – Shillong), PM-SVEP (1 Post – Shillong), DFS-FI (1 post – Ri Bhoi), DFS-NFLP (1 post – Ri Bhoi) and DFS-SISD (1 post – Garo Region).

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Essential: Post Graduate Degree from a recognised University/Institution in Business Administration (Marketing), Rural Management, Agri-Business/Rural Development, Economics, Commerce. Minimum 5 years of post-qualification experience in marketing, enterprise promotion or market linkages, of which at least 2 years should be in the social/community development sector, preferably in non-farm livelihoods promotion. Experience in: (i) strategic marketing planning and promotion of products of SHGs, producer groups or micro-enterprises; (ii) developing market linkages, branding, packaging and retail/institutional buyer tie-ups; (iii) online and offline campaign development, including social media, e-commerce platforms and content marketing. Proficiency in MS Office/ Canva/ Adobe and internet applications. Working knowledge of English and at least one local language (Khasi/Garo/Pnar). Within 35 years of age. Desirable: Experience in rural development externally funded rural livelihood projects, with a focus on promoting rural enterprises, strengthening community institutions and linking rural producers to markets. Exposure to working with Community Based Organization (SHGs, Village Organizations, Cluster Level Federations), and to trade fairs, exhibitions and sales outlets such as Saras. Experience with GeM, ONDC or other e-commerce platforms. Certification or formal training in rural marketing, entrepreneurship development, value chain management, or digital marketing from a recognized institution (Mandatory). Post Graduate Degree in Business Management - Finance/Mathematics/Commerce or related field from recognized University/Institution. Minimum 5 years of working experience in a Business/Producer Organization Livelihoods related Projects, Start-up Village Entrepreneurship Programme, Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation Programmes. Should have strong numerical and business finance understanding and skill. Individuals having experience in training rural masses are preferred. Fluency in English and local languages. Within 35 years of age. Post Graduate/Graduate degree in Rural Development/ Business Management-Finance/Commerce from a recognized University or Institution. Minimum 3 years' experience in Rural Development and Poverty Alleviation Programmes. Having worked in a Non Banking Financial Company (NBFC)/ Micro Finance Institutions (MFI). Having Computer Skills with emphasis on Microsoft Packages, Google Suite, Microsoft word/excel etc. Within 35 years of age. Post Graduate/Graduate Degree in Commerce/ Marketing/Business Administration from a recognized University or Institution. Minimum 3 years of experience in marketing roles, with progressively increasing responsibility. Experience in strategic planning, online/ offline campaign development. Demonstrated success in managing affiliate marketing related activities. content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The two Project Manager posts pay ₹46,800/- per month. The three District Functional Specialist posts pay ₹39,000/- per month. The notice does not mention any allowance on top of this pay. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis. No claim whatsoever can be made for any permanent position with the Government or any organization under it. All posts are transferable. The job requires extensive tours and night stays in remote rural areas of the state. It also involves staying at villages for about 15 days in a month. Only candidates willing to undertake such travels and stays may apply.

content_sections.text: Open the MSRLS website (msrls.nic.in) and go to Notice Board -> Recruitment, where the application link is provided. Submit the online application between 10:00 am on 12 November 2026 and 5:00 pm on 26 November 2026. Fill in a correct and active e-mail address and contact number. MSRLS will use them for correspondence and takes no responsibility if a mail bounces. Upload self-attested copies of the documents listed below, in PDF format only, with a maximum document size of up to 10MB. Do not pay any fee. No application fee is required with the application. Documents named in the notice: Certificate for the Highest Educational Qualification only. A Marksheet, Provisional Certificate or Completion Certificate of the latest qualification may be uploaded as proof. Working Experience Certificate / No Objection Certificate only (Internship Certificate not allowed). Curriculum Vitae (CV). Proof of Date of Birth as per the Birth Certificate issued by the Registrar of Births & Deaths or as entered in Matriculation. Any address proof duly Certified/Issued by the Government (e.g. Valid Indian Passport/EPIC/Driving License/Aadhar Card). Candidates working in any private or public sector organisation may furnish a No Objection Certificate from their controlling authority at the final stage of selection. For queries, candidates can email [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be informed by e-mail. They will then go through a multi-modal selection process. The process will include a preliminary examination, followed by a group discussion, a skill test and/or any other tests MSRLS may decide. Preliminary examination: tests the verbal, quantitative and analytical abilities of the candidates. It will be held at Shillong. Group discussion, skill test and/or other tests: as MSRLS may decide. Candidates will be screened at every stage of the examination. Candidates appearing for the examination will not be paid any TA/DA. The notice does not give the examination date. Call letters will be sent by email, and recruitment updates will appear on the MSRLS website.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 5 vacancies: one each for PM-NFM, PM-SVEP, DFS-FI, DFS-NFLP and DFS-SISD.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes at 5:00 pm on 26 November 2026. It opens at 10:00 am on 12 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for the MSRLS posts?
faq.answer: The Project Manager posts need a Post Graduate Degree in the listed subjects and a minimum of 5 years of experience. The District Functional Specialist posts need a Post Graduate/Graduate degree in the listed subjects and a minimum of 3 years of experience. All candidates need at least 45% marks.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be within 35 years of age. SC/ST candidates get a relaxation of five years, and PwD candidates get ten years (fifteen years for SC/ST).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for MSRLS Project Manager and District Functional Specialist posts?
faq.answer: Project Managers get ₹46,800/- per month and District Functional Specialists get ₹39,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee for MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The guidelines state that no application fee is required to be paid with the application.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link on msrls.nic.in under Notice Board -> Recruitment. Upload your highest qualification certificate, your experience certificate or NOC, and your CV in PDF format, up to 10MB.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for MSRLS posts?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will take a preliminary examination at Shillong, which tests verbal, quantitative and analytical abilities. This is followed by a group discussion, skill test and/or other tests as MSRLS may decide.

faq.question: Q9. Who can apply for MSRLS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The advertisement invites applications from the citizens of Meghalaya. Local candidates will be given preference.

faq.question: Q10. Is the MSRLS job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely temporary and on a contractual basis, and no claim can be made for any permanent position. All posts are transferable.
